thread:
priya: quick question from the multi-currency spike: should we store billing currency on the envelope/root level or keep it per-span and canonicalize later? want to capture tradeoffs before the RFC follow-up writeup.

maria: leaning envelope-first. single join point for billing reduces expensive span scans. downside: envelope cardinality goes up and we might mask span-level overrides.

alex: implementation note: our shard/router keys favor envelope attrs, so envelope.currency is cheap for routing. adding it will slightly increase partitioning variance.

jonathan: billing math perspective: prefer to keep raw amount + currency untouched in raw storage and do USD conversion in the billing pipeline where we can use historical FX rates. audits need raw values.

lina: agree with jonathan. propose: envelope.primary_currency required, span.currency allowed as override. billing job uses span.currency when present. we'll validate ISO-4217 uppercase at ingest.

priya: OK. two migration concerns: (1) many old traces only have span.currency; (2) some clients send nonstandard codes (e.g., 'usd', 'US$').

sam: for (1) backfill option: run a targeted job that reads traces missing envelope.primary_currency and writes an envelope attr using the modal span.currency for that trace. Do pilot then bulk. For (2) add a small normalizer at ingest that uppercases and strips symbols, but put bad-format cases into a validation queue instead of rejecting.

alex: add a runtime feature-flag to start accepting envelope.primary_currency so we can flip canary without breaking old producers. also emit metric ingest.envelope_currency_present_ratio.

maria: also a detector: nightly job that compares span.currency <> envelope.primary_currency and surfaces percentage mismatches. threshold alert if >0.1% of traces differ.

jonathan: suggested config excerpt for validator: ```yaml
billing_schema:
  envelope_required: [billing_key, tenant_id, primary_currency]
  span_overrides: [currency]
  currency_validation: {iso: true, uppercase: true, strip_symbols: true}
```

priya: we should not canonicalize to USD at ingest. billing pipeline will query FX archive (versioned) and perform conversion. also need to design how we store FX provenance (source, timestamp).

lina: migration plan bullets: pilot backfill 48h window -> validate metrics -> expand to 30d -> full. create runbook for revert if mismatch spikes.

sam: query compatibility: add a planner rewrite rule that for billing joins expands "coalesce(span.currency, envelope.primary_currency)". Deprecate direct span-only joins in docs.

alex: ops: lightweight gateway enrich can copy span.currency -> envelope.primary_currency when envelope missing (behind feature flag). good for early rollout.

infra-bot: scheduled: feature-flag "ingest.envelope_primary_currency" will be canaried in prod at 2024-06-18T11:00:00Z.

maria: next steps: @alex draft ingest validator + feature-flag PR; @lina draft backfill + pilot schedule; @jonathan define FX archive API and conversion task; @priya add validation metric + alert. I'll write the RFC follow-up doc and link these action items.

priya: thanks all. please ack here when PRs are up.

alex: will send PR by EOD.

lina: backfill plan in my draft tomorrow.

jonathan: FX prototype started.

sam: will add planner rewrite and deprecation note.

maria: ok locking decision unless objections by EOD. +1?

priya: +1
